title.narrative: Health service delivery improved significantly, resulting in 90 per cent coverage of measles vaccination and 100 per cent coverage of polio vaccination in target populations and a 10 per cent increase in four or more ANC visits. Also, 1,357 adolescent girls and young women at risk for HIV infection were identified, 69 per cent were timely linked to multisectoral services.Cold chain space was increased by 23 per cent.
